title: Attitude and reasons of physicans in prescribing specialised home palliative care (SHPC)
summary:
Specialized home palliative care (SHPC) is feasible if a specific form (named Muster63) is filled by a physican. 
In a retrospective analysis (2014 - 2017) we saw a great difference in the local distribution of the patients. This study investigate reasons for this heterogeneity.

interventions.name: Physicans (general practioneers, pediatricans) in clinics and hospitals in the center part of Hesse, Germany who wants to participate in the study are asked to anwer a questionnaire.
